# Ahmed Farid Zahidi — theafz.github.io

> Personal portfolio of Ahmed Farid Zahidi, a BS-MS Dual Degree student at IISER Thiruvananthapuram studying Physics, Mathematics, and Data Science — researcher, developer, and science communicator with interests spanning theoretical physics, AI, and scientific computing.

Ahmed is a second-year student on the DMP (Data Science, Physics, Mathematics) pre-major track at IISER Thiruvananthapuram, originally from Kolkata, West Bengal. His long-term ambition is to become a multidisciplinary scientist spanning theoretical physics, AI, robotics, genetics, and science communication.

This site is a single-page portfolio featuring an animated SVG orbit diagram, constellation cursor trail, and sections covering his academic journey, technical skills, projects, and long-term roadmaps. The aesthetic is deep space navy and brass gold, built with vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript and deployed via GitHub Pages.

## About

- [Homepage](https://theafz.github.io/): Full portfolio — academic background, skills, projects, and roadmaps in one page.

## Academic & Research

Ahmed studies at one of India's premier science institutes (IISER TVM), with research interests in:
- Theoretical physics (electrodynamics, quantum mechanics, wormholes)
- Applied mathematics and mathematical modelling
- Scientific computing and data science
- AI and machine learning fundamentals

He cracked five national entrance exams — JEE Main, JEE Advanced, WBJEE, IAT, and CUET — before joining IISER.

## Skills & Technologies

- **Languages & Frameworks:** Python, JavaScript, LaTeX
- **Libraries & Tools:** Three.js, MediaPipe, scientific computing stack
- **Domains:** Computer vision, ML fundamentals, spatial computing, 3D graphics, mathematical modelling, scientific communication, visual design

## Projects

- Personal portfolio site (this site) — single-file HTML/CSS/JS with SVG orbit diagram, scroll animations, holographic card hovers, animated skill bars, and a gradient progress bar with spark particles.
- JARVIS/FRIDAY-style Python personal assistant (in development)
- Goodword Books blog admin panel — React/Next.js multi-store publishing platform for goodwordindia.com, goodwordbooks.com, and goodwordbangla.com
